label: source-ssh-auth-diagnosis-fix
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=<WORKDIR>/E4/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i <WORKDIR>/E4/id_ed25519 -p 22144 root@127.0.0.1 bash -s
script:
set -eux
journalctl -u e4-sshd --no-pager -n 20
sed -i 's/UsePAM no/UsePAM yes/' /srv/e4/ssh/sshd_config
systemctl stop e4-sshd
systemd-run --unit=e4-sshd /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -f /srv/e4/ssh/sshd_config
mv /root/e4/derivatives.tar /root/e4/derivatives-before-auth-fix.tar
tar -cpf /root/e4/derivatives.tar /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections /srv/e4/ssh /srv/e4/browser /srv/e4/redis /srv/e4/credential.cred /var/lib/postgresql/15/main
sha256sum /root/e4/derivatives.tar
